flags_and_checks.component_evidence_missing: Recover the mesh and component record before attributing part errors.
flags_and_checks.scale_evidence_missing: Recover the original length estimate and compare it with a known scale reference.
flags_and_checks.catalog_length_differs_by_factor_1_5: Check units and match all three dimensions to the observed mesh.
flags_and_checks.light_object_overestimated_by_factor_2: Check for unsupported solid volumes and use a section or a thin-layer calculation where geometrically supported.
flags_and_checks.single_part_has_70_percent_of_mass: Inspect the dominant part's mask, volume, and material. Concentration may be correct.
flags_and_checks.shell_occupies_at_least_95_percent_of_al: Check shell thickness and the allocated cross-section. A filled shell may also reflect an undersized envelope.
flags_and_checks.part_hits_upper_calibration_limit: Check which geometry or material assumption requires the calibration increase.
flags_and_checks.drawer_fronts_without_explicit_internal_: Check if sides, bottoms and runners are already included in another part. Model them individually if missing.
flags_and_checks.mattress_and_frame_share_object_envelope: Check if rail and bedding volumes use physically disjoint geometry, and whether internal mattress voids are already represented.
flags_and_checks.no_threshold_triggered: Compare part geometry and material with independent measurements if error remains.
